metric_labels.popularity_bias: review-coverage-bias@K: share of top-K from products with >= 1 embedded review (not popularity)
metric_labels.review_cap_bias: review-cap-bias@K (v2): share of top-K at the 20-review graph cap (5 embedded reviews)
metric_labels.head_popularity_bias: head-popularity-bias@K (v2): share of top-K in top-10% catalogue review_count >= P90
